description: This file contains the implementation of an in-memory queue cache with backpressure detection and cursor management, used for stream message buffering in Orleans.

classes.name: CacheBucket
classes.description: Tracks the number of items and cursors pointing to a specific cache bucket for backpressure detection.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheItem
classes.description: Represents an individual item in the queue cache, including its batch, sequence token, and associated cache bucket.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCache
classes.description: Main in-memory queue cache class implementing IQueueCache, managing message addition, cursor positioning, and cache purging.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current number of items in the cache.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Provides the maximum number of items that can be added in a single operation.

methods.name: SimpleQueueCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with specified size and logger.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Indicates whether the cache is under backpressure based on bucket cursors count.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge oldest messages from the cache if no cursors are pointing to the oldest bucket.

methods.name: DrainBucket
methods.description: Removes all items within a specific cache bucket and returns their batch containers.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds multiple messages to the cache.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cache cursor at a specified sequence token.

methods.name: InitializeCursor
methods.description: Positions a cursor within the cache based on a sequence token.

methods.name: RefreshCursor
methods.description: Reinitializes a cursor's position based on the current cache state and a sequence token.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to move the cursor forward and retrieve the next batch message.

methods.name: AdvanceCursor
methods.description: Moves a cursor to a specified cache item, updating bucket cursor counts.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.description: Sets a cursor to a specific cache item and updates bucket cursor counts.

methods.name: UnsetCursor
methods.description: Unsets a cursor and updates cursor counts in the associated bucket.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a single batch message to the cache, managing buckets and linked list.
